name: Argon2 Password Hasher & Key Derivation
desc: Generate and verify Argon2 (Argon2id, Argon2i, Argon2d) password hashes and key derivations with customizable memory, time iterations, and parallelism locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: BIP39 Mnemonic Phrase Generator & Seed Verifier
desc: Generate, inspect, and verify BIP39 mnemonic phrases, calculate checksums, and derive PBKDF2 seed keys in client browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: ChaCha20
desc: Encrypt and decrypt payloads locally using RFC 8439 ChaCha20 stream cipher with Poly1305 AEAD authentication. 100% client-side memory execution, zero network egress.

name: Diceware Passphrase Generator
desc: Generate high-entropy, cryptographically secure passphrases locally using the EFF Diceware wordlist and hardware PRNG in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: HMAC Generator & Keyed
desc: Generate and verify Hash-based Message Authentication Codes (HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA512, HMAC-SHA384, HMAC-SHA1) with secret keys locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: PBKDF2 Key Derivation & Password Hasher
desc: Derive cryptographic keys and compute PBKDF2 hashes using HMAC-SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-512, and HMAC-SHA-1 with customizable iterations and salts locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: PGP & OpenPGP Text Encryptor, Decryptor & Key Inspector
desc: Encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify, and inspect OpenPGP armor keys and messages locally in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: RSA Key Pair Generator & Key Inspector
desc: Generate cryptographically secure RSA key pairs (2048, 3072, 4096-bit) and export in PEM (PKCS#1, PKCS#8, SPKI) or JWK formats locally in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Shamir's Secret Sharing Scheme (SSSS)
desc: Split secrets into cryptographic threshold shares and reconstruct original payloads locally using Shamir

name: TOTP & HOTP Authenticator Token Generator
desc: Generate and verify RFC 6238 TOTP and RFC 4226 HOTP two-factor authentication codes locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: UUID / GUID Generator & Validator
desc: Generate and validate cryptographically secure RFC 4122 Version 4 (Random), Version 1 (Timestamp-based), Version 7 (Unix Epoch), and Nil UUIDs locally in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
